- If the buyer is unrealistic, reset expectations quickly and move to your next number.
- Emphasize transaction efficiency, straightforwardness, and getting the deal done today.

I've already cut it to $40,000 — that's a solid deal. Your offer of $9,844 doesn't cover half that. I'm not chasing pennies here. If you're ready to step up to the right number, we can get this done today. Otherwise, I've got other buyers who understand the value. My price is firm.

[PRICE] 2023 Ford Mustang GT Premium: $40000.00
